chapters.label: Cardiff, 2002
chapters.text: Cardiff, 2002, the FA Cup final. Arsenal lead Chelsea one–nil. Freddie Ljungberg races from his own half, past John Terry... and curls it in! Two–nil!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. He runs straight at the defence. Terry slides in, but Freddie skips over his leg and keeps the ball.

chapters.label: The curl
chapters.text: From behind the goal, see the curl. He aims outside the far post, and it bends back in, past Cudicini!

chapters.label: Curl it far
chapters.text: Run at defenders, then look up. Use the inside of your foot and curl it into the far corner!
